notes: Before/refined and explicitly historical states retain reproduced issues. The final states selected in assertions supply the current pass evidence. Browser engine/version and actual touch, safe-area, enlarged-text, Safari and Firefox coverage remain unavailable or unperformed.

toolMetrics uses bounding-box height to include controls. Descendants of collapsed details and screen-reader-only headings may still have boxes; do not interpret its raw controls/headings lists as proof of on-screen visibility. Screenshots, AX observations, the expanded missing-photo state and explicit selector observations establish visibility.

Older toolMetrics.heading fields may identify a hidden mounted Photo Studio heading. The explicit more-tools-visible-header-and-tabs state records the visible working header; the 1px Import menu heading is intentionally screen-reader-only.

weekly-missing-hours-phone and tools-weekly-validation-phone.jpg show Import after a hot reload and are not evidence of the weekly validation state. The actual missing-hours error is recorded in weekly-suggestions-desktop.

import-older-save-complete-newest-still-saving was captured after both requests had completed and is not overlap proof. Use observed-older-save-complete-newest-saving, which includes one completed request, the next received request and visible Saving draft text.

The exact overlap observation predates the shared import footer and proves persistence status only. The final import failure/retry screenshots prove the current footer. Earlier small-phone footer rows predate the removal of duplicate bottom-space reservation; use final-small-phone-single-footer-reservation.

Local fixture: manual import remains an unreviewed draft. The final description is restored and saved. All seven opening days are 11:00–21:00 in America/New_York. Weekly Edit this promotion created a local unapproved Rigatoni for lunch draft. Stress prices of 900 and 1850 were existing fixture data. No image generation, paid action, upload approval or publication was performed.

Activity initial loading, populated refresh failure, retry and zero-value empty states used a temporary local response gateway. Its request profile was cleared, the gateway stopped and browser returned to localhost:5173. Retry events contain no request bodies or credentials.

UX-24.5 remains open for remaining capability/state coverage and shared-pattern review, including staff review, batch progress and the older Campaigns editor. Activity/import coverage is partial evidence for UX-30; it does not pass the whole-site operational criteria.
